priorityList: Maintain Arcane Intellect at all times.
Use offensive Trinkets, Potions, and Racials specifically when casting Frozen Orb, Ray of Frost, or if the fight is about to end.
Cast Blizzard immediately if the Freezing Rain buff is active.
Cast Flurry if Brain Freeze is active (unless Icy Veins is already active and extending via Thermal Void).
Cast Ice Lance if you have 2 stacks of Fingers of Frost.
Cast Frozen Orb on cooldown to generate Icicles and Fingers of Frost.
Cast Glacial Spike when at maximum Icicles.
Cast Ice Lance whenever you have any stacks of Fingers of Frost.
Cast Ice Lance if the target has 6 or more stacks of the Freezing debuff to trigger Splinterstorm.
Cast Ice Nova if talented into Cone of Frost.
Cast Cone of Cold if talented into Cone of Frost to reset the cooldown of Frozen Orb and Comet Storm.
Cast Blizzard as a secondary priority if there are 5 or more enemies and Frozen Orb is on cooldown.
Cast Ray of Frost if you have fewer than 3 Icicles or immediately after using a potion.
Cast Frostbolt as your primary filler to generate Icicles and Brain Freeze procs.
